summary.en-US: Understand extension permissions and review meaningful changes without sending browser data anywhere.

release_notes.en-US: Introduces Watchdog shield artwork for the Firefox toolbar, popup, dashboard, and change notifications, plus a visual refresh based on its navy, blue, and amber palette. Every permission and website-access finding now includes a plain-language explanation of why that access may matter. Recent activity now presents permission and website-access changes as explicit added (+) or removed (−) diffs alongside version changes. Extension Watchdog's own permissions, data practices, and local-only behavior are unchanged.

version.approval_notes:
Version 0.1.3 is a user-interface and reviewability update. The generic shield icon is replaced by a packaged PNG rendering of the Watchdog shield artwork at 16, 32, 48, 96, and 128 pixels. The same artwork appears in the dashboard, popup, and notification. The obsolete SVG icon files are removed.

Permission and host-access findings now show a second, plain-language explanation of why the capability may matter. The explanation does not change classification, permissions, data collection, or extension behavior. Change history already stored added permissions, added host access, removed access, and version changes; the dashboard now renders those values as explicit + added and − removed diff entries.

The requested permissions remain management, storage, and notifications. There are still no host permissions and no content scripts. No network behavior, telemetry, remote service, or management mutation API was introduced. All strings continue to be rendered with textContent. Automated tests pass, Mozilla lint reports 0 errors, warnings, and notices, and the listed-release source package builds successfully.
